changes: Resolved B-META-framework-audit:F-009 through Lattice finding_resolve as a stale/superseded original Layer2 no-formal-path finding. Added B-9833 audit evidence, transcript-diff, review passes, and validation evidence; no business source code or decision docs were changed by this story.
usage: Use lattice finding_list {"storyId":"B-META-framework-audit"} to inspect F-009 status. Use lattice capability_claim_formal_evaluate --target=engineering --format=json to confirm formal claim remains fail-closed when proof artifacts are missing.
expectedOutcome: F-009 is no longer an open high/suspected audit finding, but Lattice does not claim Layer2 unlock, Production Safety, global Capability, receiptVerified, productionDone, or fullAuthorityDone from this story.
actualTranscript: finding_list shows B-META-framework-audit:F-009 status=resolved and attention.suspected=[]. capability_claim_formal_evaluate --target=engineering returns authorized=false, outcome=EXPECTED_BLOCK, layer2EngineeringClaim=LOCKED, productionSafetyClaim=LOCKED, globalCapabilityClaim=LOCKED, receiptVerified=false, productionDone=false, fullAuthorityDone=false. gap_analyze still reports one high Layer4 customerKeyRef gap. convergence_check is false because of that gap and unfinished stories, while Audit backlog passes.
outcomeDiff: No difference for B-9833 scope. Global convergence is intentionally still false due separate Layer4 customerKeyRef and other active stories.
limitations: Layer2 capability is not unlocked by this story. Layer4 customerKeyRef remains a separate high gap and Production/global authority claims remain locked.
pitfalls: finding_resolve is REVIEW-phase gateEvidence for normal stories; attempting it from DEV was correctly rejected. B-META resolution had to be done through the main-shared audit container and then merged back into the story worktree.
